design_notes: Use hairline rules between table rows and sidebar sections.
Accent colour: a muted blue or steel grey for table headers and sidebar title.
Pull-quote: larger serif font, italic, with a thin left rule in accent colour.
No icons or decorative imagery; rely on typographic hierarchy.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Western Railway has been a client since 2006 and contributed 52% of the orders on hand as of the date of the DRHP.
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone contributed 52% of the order book, and the top customers together accounted for 57% of fiscal 2018 revenue.
pull_quotes.rationale: Customer concentration is the single most important risk; a pull-quote makes it unavoidable.
